Class.summary: Controller responsible for retrieving the chronological activity timeline and immutable audit trail for support tickets.
Class.remarks: Route prefix: api/v1/tickets/{ticketId}/activities. All activity endpoints require authentication and enforce ticket-level ownership access control.

Constructor.summary: Initializes a new instance of the class.
Constructor.param: The MediatR mediator instance used for dispatching activity queries.
The service used to obtain the current authenticated user's ID and role from JWT claims.

GetActivities.summary: Retrieves the chronological audit trail and activity history for a specific support ticket.
GetActivities.remarks: Access is governed by ticket ownership rules: Admin: Can access the activity timeline of any ticket. SupportAgent: Can access activities for tickets assigned to them. Customer: Can access activities for tickets they created. Activity Types Recorded: Created: Ticket submission by customer. StatusChanged: Status transitions (includes OldValue and NewValue). PriorityChanged: Priority adjustments by admin (includes OldValue and NewValue). AgentAssigned: Assignment of support agent. CommentAdded: When a new public comment is posted. TimeLogged: When work duration is recorded by an agent. Closed: Final ticket closure event.
GetActivities.param: The unique identifier (GUID) of the parent ticket.
GetActivities.returns: A chronological list of activity log entries including event type, user name, descriptions, and audit timestamps.
GetActivities.response: Returns the full activity timeline for the ticket.
If the provided ticket ID is not a valid GUID format.
If the request lacks a valid Bearer token.
If the ticket does not exist or the caller lacks permission to view it.
